title: Console activation waves: training, comms matrix, and cross-team runbook for Insights & Cost cards
creator: Diego Morales
description: Coordinated activation plan to ship the new Insights dashboards, rollout controls, and granular cost breakdown cards in the Console. This ticket owns the cross-functional orchestration: release notes copy, staged activation waves (canary, pilot, general), training and enablement artifacts, and a comms matrix for GTM. Focus is on minimizing user confusion during the cost-breakdown opt-in and ensuring support and sales have playbooks for troubleshooting and upsell opportunities.
goals: Deliver clear release notes and console inline help for the new Insights dashboards and cost cards
Execute a three-wave activation with canary -> pilot -> GA to limit blast radius
Equip support, sales, and solutions with training, diagnostics runbook, and Q&A
Measure activation acceptance and impact on billing telemetry and query latency
success_metrics: <10% increase in average support tickets per org in first 2 weeks
>70% utilization of cost-breakdown card for pilot cohort within 30 days
No regression in 95th percentile Console API latency post-GA
Release notes opened/clicked rate >= 30% by active devs in first week
acceptance_criteria: Release notes and console inline tooltips approved by PM and Design
Train-the-trainer session scheduled and recorded; materials uploaded to Drive
Activation automation (feature flag gating) integrated with rollout service and tested
Support runbook and common troubleshooting KB article published
Telemetry dashboards for adoption and error-rate monitoring live in Console
tasks: Draft release notes blurb and one-line summary for external API changelog
Create comms matrix mapping audiences to channels and timing
Prepare support playbook with step-by-step repro and escalations
Record 45min train-the-trainer + Q&A and capture sample scripts
Coordinate with Engineering to schedule canary cohort and rollback window
QA acceptance: validate cost numbers match billing export for sample orgs
Publish quickstart cards and contextual help links in the Console UI
training_plan: Week 1: Internal train-the-trainer session and slide deck review
Week 2: Office hours with engineering to cover failure modes and logs
Week 3: Customer-facing webinar for pilot cohort and feedback collection
On-demand: 10-minute product walkthrough video and FAQ doc
communication_assets: External release notes (changelog) one-paragraph + details link
Console banner copy and link to quickstart
Support canned responses and escalation checklist
Sales one-pager highlighting upgrade signals and upsell hooks
Internal launch email template for company-wide awareness
release_notes_blurb: Introducing Insights dashboards: view per-route latency and a granular cost breakdown card that surfaces token-level billing drivers. Available initially to a pilot cohort; use the ‘Cost details’ card to jump to matching billing exports. See the Console inline help for migration notes and quotas.
notes_and_risks: Risk: billing mismatch edge cases for customers with custom pricing — coordinate with Finance ops
Risk: KV-cache instrumentation may add tracer overhead during pilot — require perf signoff
Mitigation: limit pilot to orgs with predictable traffic profiles and rapid rollback path
go_to_market_items: Launch email schedule for pilot -> beta -> GA cohorts
Customer success playbooks for high-value accounts
Field enablement pack for AE/SEs with objection handling
Announcements in Community Slack and monthly newsletter
